title: AWKUM Holds Third Session on Effective CV Writing & Interview Skills for Graduating Students
text:
The University
Advancement and Career Development Center (UA&CDC) at Abdul Wali Khan
University Mardan (AWKUM) successfully conducted its third session on
“Effective
CV Crafting & Interview Skills”
at IBL Hall. The session was organized
for 8th-semester students from the Faculties of Physical & Numerical
Sciences and Chemical & Life Sciences as part of the university-wide Soft
Skills Development Program.

The initiative aims to
equip graduating students with essential professional skills, particularly in
resume development and interview preparation, to help them transition smoothly
into the job market.

Dr. Muhammad Bilal,
Director UA&CDC, welcomed the participants, including students, faculty
members, and resource persons. In his address, he emphasized the importance of
preparing for the shift from academic life to the professional world. He noted that
while students may have excelled in their academic programs, they must now be
ready to face the practical challenges of the industry.

Ms. Bisma Javed, a
resource person from the Institute of Business and Leadership (IBL), delivered
an insightful session on CV writing. She explained the types of CVs employers
require, highlighted common mistakes students make, and provided practical
guidance on creating a well-structured, impactful CV that effectively presents
personal, academic, and professional strengths.

Dr. Silvia Ahmed from
IBL led the session on interview skills. She discussed strategies for
presenting oneself confidently and professionally in interviews, highlighted
common errors candidates make, and shared techniques to improve performance.
The session also included interactive mock interviews, giving students hands-on
experience and valuable feedback.
